run_metadata_upgrade: run the complete metadata upgrade pipeline for LibriBIG audiobook data with genre and speaker processing
run_genre_scraping: run the genre scraping step to retrieve and update genre metadata for all audiobooks
run_speaker_data_update: run the speaker data update to retrieve and store reader names for all audiobooks
run_duplicate_search: run the duplicate book search to find and index duplicate entries in the audiobook dataset
run_text_cleaning: run the text data cleaning step to clean and update transcription status for all audiobooks
